==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Meet up with the Ascalonians outside of Lion's Arch.
*Investigate the [[Ascalon Settlement]].
*Protect the [[Ascalonian Settler|survivors]] from the waves of [[undead]]. At least one must survive.
*Defeat the [[Candy Corn Tyrant]].
*See The Countess of Hakewood for your reward.

===Reward===
*2,000 [[Experience]]
*1,000 [[Gold]]
*50 [[Trick-or-Treat Bag]]s
*''In addition, each player will receive a Trick-or-Treat Bag for each settler that survives after the tyrant is defeated. They are added directly to your inventory without notification.

==Walkthrough==
{{section-stub}} 
{{see|Mad King's Influence}}
When a [[party]] member approaches the Ascalon Settlement (upon passing the collector [[Wintun the Black]] using the route in the wiki map on the right), Mad King's Influence and [[Minion Apocalypse]] will be applied to all party members, [[Sergeant Weststar]], [[Chance Redding]], [[Jenn Valefield]], and any [[summoning stone]] ally. Consider waiting until these effects are applied before using any summoning stones, since allies summoned after the application of those effects will not be affected by those effects. Minion Apocalypse, but not Mad King's Influence, will be applied to [[animal companion]]s, [[Ascalonian Settler]]s, and quest-related [[foe]]s (except [[minion]]s).

==Dialogue==
=== Initial dialogue ===
;The Countess of Hakewood
:''"As you are no doubt aware, despite his lack of ears, or head for that matter, [[Mad King Thorn|our liege]] is quite the avid musician. In preparation for his arrival this year, we of the [[Lunatic Court]] felt it would be appropriate to prepare a gift of the melodious variety for him. Our lord is quite fond of the music of a particular instrument. It is of course the one instrument that has the most regal of sounds: the harmonica. And as luck would have it there is a notable instrument maker who lives in the '''Ascalon Settlement'''. Would you mind heading over there to fetch one from him? You'd better hurry; I saw some other Ascalonians heading that way as well. I'd hate for them to be sold out by the time you get there."''
{{offer dialog
| accept = Of course I can help with such a simple task. What could possibly go wrong?
| decline = I think I'll stay here and eat candy, thanks.

=== Reward dialogue ===
;The Countess of Hakewood
:''"You say the town was overrun with undead Krytans? This is great news! It means our rituals to permanently resurrect King Thorn are working, though it seems they may have been a little bit off target since they resurrected his subjects instead. Did the zombies say anything that might give us a clue as to what went wrong?''

:''What's that? They said the rent was too high? Well, I suppose it's true that our lord did raise the rent in that area during his reign, and I suppose it did result in massive starvation and poverty that wiped that town off the map, but in his defense he had a perfectly good reason for it. You see, he needed the funds to hire more rent collectors.''

:''It's unfortunate that you weren't able to find a harmonica, though; I suppose that we'll just have to make do with invisible instruments like last year. Remember the three Cs: calm, collected, and C-chord. Now how do you play that on an [[Emote|air guitar]]?"''

== Notes ==
* While this quest is active and not completed, [[North Kryta Province (War in Kryta)|War in Kryta NPCs]] will not [[spawn]] in [[North Kryta Province]].
* If one party member has Evil Residents active, while another party member has [[Evil Residents Code: Harmonica]] active, Sergeant Weststar, Chance Redding, and Jenn Valefield will not spawn, so the ''"Meet up with the Ascalonians outside of Lion's Arch"'' Evil Residents objective cannot be completed. 
* When Candy Corn Tyrant dies, Mad King's Influence and Minion Apocalypse are removed from all party members. 
{{bug| The [[#Foes|minions that are not spawned by skills]] and Bone Horrors that are spawned from Minion Apocalypse are masterless, since Verata's Gaze only needs to be used once instead of twice to take control of one of these minions if Verata's Gaze does not fail because of the caster having 0 Death Magic; however, the masterless minions that are not spawned by skills ''are not hostile'' to the quest-related foes, while masterless Bone Horrors that are spawned from Minion Apocalypse ''are hostile'' to the quest-related foes.}}

== Trivia ==
* The quest name, some [[Non-player character|NPCs]], and much of its dialogue are references to the [[w:Resident Evil|Resident Evil video game series]]. 
**This quest features the three [[Guild Wars Eye of the North]] characters (Sergeant Weststar, Chance Redding, and Jenn Valefield) that are named after Resident Evil characters (Albert Wesker, Chris Redfield, and Jill Valentine, respectively). 
**All non-minion foes (with the exception of Candy Corn Tyrant) have "zombie" as part of their name, which is a reference to the zombies that are featured throughout the series.
**Candy Corn Tyrant is a reference to Tyrants that are featured as boss enemies throughout the series.
**Jenn Valefield's line ''"We think it has something to do with the resurgence of the Mad King, but so far all the teams we've sent to investigate haven't come back"'' refers to the [[w:Resident Evil (1996 video game)#Plot|beginning of Resident Evil 1]] where Alpha Team (that consists of the three Resident Evil characters that the three Guild Wars Eye of the North characters are named after) is sent to investigate after contact with Bravo Team is lost.
**Chance Redding's line ''"You mean stabbing isn't fast enough? Uhh...maybe we should try punching? It worked on a stone elemental I tried it on once!"'' refers to Chris Redfield's boulder punching that was a quick time event in the final boss battle of [[w:Resident Evil 5|Resident Evil 5]].
**Sergeant Weststar's line ''"If this thing reaches Lion's Arch, the town will be overwhelmed with zombies. Then it's just a matter of time before complete global saturation! We have to stop it!"'' refers to Albert Wesker's line in Resident Evil 5, "Uroboros will be released into the atmosphere ensuring complete global saturation."
**Jenn Valefield's line ''"Whew, I thought we were gonna be Ebon Sandwiches there"'' refers to when Barry saved Jill Valentine from a ceiling collapse in Resident Evil 1 and said "That was too close. You were almost a Jill sandwich!"
* The Countess of Hakewood's initial and reward dialogue refer to the [[Halloween/Finale#Music dialogue|music portion of the Halloween finales]].
* This quest was introduced in [[Halloween 2012]].
